stem:
Kabir dissolves sugar in water and later evaporates the water until solid sugar remains. He also tears a sheet of paper into strips.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim correctly classifies the changes?

options.text: Dissolving the sugar is reversible because the sugar can be brought back; tearing the paper is not reversible because the whole sheet cannot be brought back.
Tearing the paper is reversible because the paper material is still there.
Dissolving the sugar is not reversible.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A change is reversible only if the original substance or object can be brought back in the form it started with; sugar can, but the whole paper sheet cannot.

teacher.key_rationale: Recovering solid sugar shows dissolving is reversible; the torn sheet cannot be restored as the original whole sheet, so tearing is not reversible.
